## create functions
```{r functions}
# not in function
'%!in%' <- function(x,y)!('%in%'(x,y))

# this is the function to do the boostrap resampling
boosting_yield <- function (sdata, term, treatment) {
  k = n_rep
  # n_sample: set it equals to the original sample size
  mysamples = replicate(k, sample(sdata$yi, replace=T))
  mymeans = apply(mysamples, 2, mean, na.rm = T)
  
  # quantile
  BootsTest <- quantile(mymeans,c(0.025, 0.50, 0.975))
  Boots_outputs <- tibble(term, treatment, (exp(BootsTest[[1]])-1)*100, (exp(BootsTest[[2]])-1)*100
                          , (exp(BootsTest[[3]])-1)*100, nrow(sdata), unique(sdata$StudyID) %>% length )
  colnames(Boots_outputs) <- c("Term", "Treatment", "Low", "Mean", "High", "obs", "n_study")
  return(Boots_outputs)
}

# This is the function for linear regression
SLR_yield <- function (sdata, var_subgroup) {
  pdf( paste0('outputs/SLR_yield_', var_subgroup, ".pdf"), width=8, height=6)
  par( mar=c(2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
       , mai=c(0.6, 0.7, 0.0, 0.1)  # by inches, inner margin
       , omi = c(0.0, 0.1, 0.4, 0.1)  # by inches, outer margin
       , mgp = c(0.5, 0.5, 0) # set distance of axis
       , tcl = 0.4
       , cex.axis = 1.0
       # , las = 1
       , mfrow=c(2,2))
  
  ncol <- which(colnames(sdata) == 'Yield_C')
  respcol <- c(which(colnames(sdata) == 'BiomassCash_C'),
               seq(which(colnames(sdata) == 'BD_C'),which(colnames(sdata) == 'OC_C'),5),
               seq(which(colnames(sdata) == 'N_C'),which(colnames(sdata) == 'MBN_C'),5)) # all response columns
  
  n_results <- data.frame()
  
  for (i in 1: length(respcol)) {
    subdata <- sdata[, c(which(colnames(sdata) == 'StudyID'|colnames(sdata) == 'ExperimentID')
                                , ncol, ncol + 1, respcol[i], respcol[i]+1 )]
    
    indicator <- colnames(subdata)[6] 
    indicator <- str_sub(indicator, 1, str_length(indicator)-2)
    
    colnames(subdata) <- c("StudyID", "ExperimentID",  "Yield_C", "Yield_T", "Y_C", "Y_T")
    
    subdata <- subdata %>% filter(!is.na(Yield_C) & !is.na(Y_C) & !is.na(Y_T))
    # min(subdata$Yield_C)
    # min(subdata$Yield_T)
    subdata$Yield_C <- ifelse(subdata$Yield_C == 0, 0.001, subdata$Yield_C)
    subdata$Yield_T <- ifelse(subdata$Yield_T == 0, 0.001, subdata$Yield_T)
    
    subdata$Y_C <- ifelse(subdata$Y_C == 0, 0.001, subdata$Y_C)
    subdata$Y_T <- ifelse(subdata$Y_T == 0, 0.001, subdata$Y_T)
    
    ## aggregation -- updated for revision
    subdata %>% 
      group_by(StudyID, ExperimentID) %>% 
      summarise_each(funs = mean, Yield_C, Yield_T, Y_C, Y_T) -> subdata
      
    
    n_total <- nrow(subdata)
    n_study <- length(unique(subdata$StudyID))
    
    if (n_total > 5) {
      subdata %>% mutate(log_x = log(Y_T)-log(Y_C), y = log(Yield_T) - log(Yield_C),
                         x = Y_T / Y_C) -> subdata
      
      # plot logRR(yield) vs RR(factor)
      plot (subdata$y ~ subdata$x
            , xlab = ""
            , ylab = ""
            , pch = c(19) 
            , main = ""
            , col = c("gray")
            , data = subdata
            , las = 1)
      mtext(side = 1, text = paste0(indicator, " (RR)"), line = 2.0, cex=1.25, outer = F)
      mtext(side = 2, text = "Yield (logRR)", line = 2.5, cex=1.25, outer = F)
      
      # SLR model for factor with log transfer
      logSLR <- try(lm(y ~ log_x, data = subdata)) # error handle
      if (is(logSLR, "try-error")){
        log_intercept_a <- NA
        log_slope_b <- NA
        log_p_slope_b <- NA
        log_SLR_R2 <- NA }
      
      else {
        log_intercept_a <- summary(logSLR)$coefficients[1,1] %>% round(6)
        log_try_slope_b <- try(summary(logSLR)$coefficients[2,1]) 
        if (is(log_try_slope_b, "try-error")) {log_slope_b <- NA} else(log_slope_b <- summary(logSLR)$coefficients[2,1] %>% round(6))
        if (is(log_try_slope_b, "try-error")) {log_p_slope_b <- NA} else(log_p_slope_b <- summary(logSLR)$coefficients[2,4] %>% round(6))
        log_SLR_R2 <- summary(logSLR)$r.squared %>% round(6)
        if (is(log_try_slope_b, "try-error")) {log_student_res <- NA} else(subdata$log_student_res = rstandard(logSLR))
        if (is(log_try_slope_b, "try-error")) {predict_yield_log <- NA} else(subdata$predict_yield_log = predict(logSLR))
      }
      
      # SLR model for factor without log transfer
      SLR <- try(lm(y ~ x, data = subdata)) # error handle
      if (is(SLR, "try-error")){
        intercept_a <- NA
        slope_b <- NA
        p_slope_b <- NA
        SLR_R2 <- NA }
      
      else {
        intercept_a <- summary(SLR)$coefficients[1,1] %>% round(6)
        try_slope_b <- try(summary(SLR)$coefficients[2,1]) 
        if (is(try_slope_b, "try-error")) {slope_b <- NA} else(slope_b <- summary(SLR)$coefficients[2,1] %>% round(6))
        if (is(try_slope_b, "try-error")) {p_slope_b <- NA} else(p_slope_b <- summary(SLR)$coefficients[2,4] %>% round(6))
        SLR_R2 <- summary(SLR)$r.squared %>% round(6)
        if (is(log_try_slope_b, "try-error")) {student_res <- NA} else(subdata$student_res = rstandard(SLR))
        if (is(log_try_slope_b, "try-error")) {predict_yield <- NA} else(subdata$predict_yield = predict(SLR))
      }
      
      model_prems <- data.frame(indicator, n_total, n_study, intercept_a, slope_b, p_slope_b, SLR_R2, 
                                log_intercept_a, log_slope_b, log_p_slope_b, log_SLR_R2)
      n_results <- rbind(n_results, model_prems)
      
      # add regression line
      if(p_slope_b < 0.05 & !is.na(p_slope_b)) {
        curve(intercept_a + slope_b * x, min(subdata$x), 
              max(subdata$x), col = "black", lwd = 2, add = T)} 
      # else{next}
      
      ## plot residuals (raw)
      plot (subdata$student_res ~ subdata$predict_yield
            , xlab = ""
            , ylab = ""
            , pch = c(19) 
            , main = ""
            , col = c("black")
            , data = subdata
            , las = 1)
      abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
      mtext(side = 1, text = paste0("Predicted yield", " (RR)"), line = 2.0, cex=1.25, outer = F)
      mtext(side = 2, text = "Standard residuals", line = 2.5, cex=1.25, outer = F)
      
      
      # plot logRR(yield) vs logRR(factor)
      plot (subdata$y ~ subdata$log_x
            , xlab = ""
            , ylab = ""
            , pch = c(19) 
            , main = ""
            , col = c("gray")
            , data = subdata
            , las = 1)
      mtext(side = 1, text = paste0(indicator, " (logRR)"), line = 2.0, cex=1.25, outer = F)
      mtext(side = 2, text = "Yield (logRR)", line = 2.5, cex=1.25, outer = F)
      
      # add regression line
      if(log_p_slope_b < 0.05 & !is.na(log_p_slope_b)) {
        curve(log_intercept_a + log_slope_b * x, min(subdata$log_x), 
              max(subdata$log_x), col = "black", lwd = 2, add = T)} 
      # else{next}
      
      ## plot residuals (log)
      plot (subdata$log_student_res ~ subdata$predict_yield_log
            , xlab = ""
            , ylab = ""
            , pch = c(19) 
            , main = ""
            , col = c("black")
            , data = subdata
            , las = 1)
      abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
      mtext(side = 1, text = paste0("Predicted yield", " (logRR)"), line = 2.0, cex=1.25, outer = F)
      mtext(side = 2, text = "Standardized residuals", line = 2.5, cex=1.25, outer = F)
      
    }
  }
  dev.off()
  n_results$improved_R2 = (n_results$log_SLR_R2 - n_results$SLR_R2)/n_results$SLR_R2 * 100 %>% round(3)
  return(n_results)
}



# function for normal distribution test and visulization
plot_norm <- function(sdata) {
  sdata %>% 
    ggplot(aes(yi)) + 
    geom_histogram(fill = "gray", col = "black") +
    stat_function(fun = dnorm,
                  args = list(mean = mean(sdata$yi, na.rm = TRUE),
                              sd = sd(sdata$yi, na.rm = T)),
                  col = "red",
                  alpha = 0) +
    labs(x = "Log ratio of means",
         y = "Count") -> plot_normal
  
  sdata %>% 
    ggplot(aes(sample = yi)) +
    stat_qq() + 
    stat_qq_line() +
    labs(x = "Normal theoretical quantile",
         y = "Normal data quantile") -> plot_qq
  
  plot_normal / plot_qq -> plot_normal
  return(plot_normal)
}

                       labels = seq(-90,90,30))
}
```

```{r load data}
  mutate(DepthGroup = case_when(SamplingDepth %in% c("0-to-1.5","0-to-10","0-to-12","0-to-15","0-to-18",
                                                     "0-to-2.5","0-to-20","0-to-21.3","0-to-23.5","0-to-24",
                                                     "0-to-25","0-to-26","0-to-28","0-to-3","0-to-30","0-to-30.5",
                                                     "0-to-5","0-to-7.5","0-to-8","10-to-15","10-to-20","10-to-30",
                                                     "12-to-16","15-to-20","15-to-25","15-to-30","18-to-27",
                                                     "2-to-20","2-to-7","2.5-to-5","20-to-30","4-to-8","5-to-10",
                                                     "5-to-15","5-to-20","5-to-7.5","6-to-13",

                                SamplingDepth %in% c("20-to-40","20-to-70","21-to-80","25-to-35","25-to-50","18-to-36",

                        TRUE~"NotAvailable")) -> SoilHealthDB
# test results
SoilHealthDB %>% dplyr::select (Texture, TextureGroup) %>% filter(TextureGroup == "NotAvailable") %>% distinct(Texture)
unique(SoilHealthDB[which((SoilHealthDB$Texture=="")),]$TextureGroup)

# Modify Cover crop group
SoilHealthDB$CoverCropGroup %>% unique()
SoilHealthDB %>% 
  mutate(CoverCropGroup = case_when(CoverCropGroup %in% c("Rye", "Grass", "LL") ~ "Grass",
                                    CoverCropGroup %in% c("Legume") ~ "Legume",
                                    CoverCropGroup %in% c("Brassica", "Broadleaf", "Broadleaf/Brassica", "BG") ~ "Broadleaf",
                                    CoverCropGroup %in% c("LG", "MOT") ~ "LG",
                                    CoverCropGroup %in% c("No") ~ "No CC",
                                    CoverCropGroup %in% c("AVG", "Mixed") ~ "MTT",
                                    TRUE ~ "Not available")) -> SoilHealthDB

# Create conservation group
SoilHealthDB$Conservation_Type %>% unique()
SoilHealthDB %>% 
  mutate(ConservationGroup = case_when(Conservation_Type %in% c("CC") ~ "CC",
                                       Conservation_Type %in% c("AF") ~ "AF",
                                       Conservation_Type %in% c("OF") ~ "OF",
                                       Conservation_Type %in% c("NT", "RT") ~ "NTRT",
                                       Conservation_Type %in% c("IN", "RO", "PF", "RD", "ST", "SR") ~ "Others",
                                       Conservation_Type %in% c("CC-NT", "OF-CC", "OF-NT", "NT-SR") ~ "Mixed",
                                       TRUE ~ "Not available" )) -> SoilHealthDB

SoilHealthDB %>% count(ConservationGroup)

# Create cash crop group
SoilHealthDB$GrainCropGroup %>% unique()
SoilHealthDB %>% 
  mutate(GrainCropGroup = case_when(GrainCropGroup %in% c("") ~ "Not available",
                                    GrainCropGroup %in% c("Soybean") ~ "Soybean",
                                    GrainCropGroup %in% c("Corn", "Maize") ~ "Corn",
```

## Evaluate whether a factor should be log transfered - updated for revision
```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=9}
## create a function to test normal distribution (RR vs logRR)
factor_normal_test <- function(sdata, factor_C, factor_T, x_label) {
  factor_C <- enquo(factor_C)
  factor_T <- enquo(factor_T)
  
  sdata %>% 
    dplyr::select(StudyID, ExperimentID, Top_Climate, TextureGroup, ConservationGroup,
                  CoverCropGroup, GrainCropGroup, !!factor_C, !!factor_T, Yield_C, Yield_T) -> sdata 
  
  colnames(sdata) = c('StudyID', 'ExperimentID', 'Top_Climate', 'TextureGroup', 'ConservationGroup',
                  'CoverCropGroup', 'GrainCropGroup', 'factor_C', 'factor_T', 'Yield_C', 'Yield_T')
  
  sdata %>% filter(!is.na(factor_C) & !is.na(factor_T)) %>% 
    mutate(RR = factor_T / factor_C, logRR = log(factor_T / factor_C),
           RR_yield = Yield_T/Yield_C, logRR_yield = log(Yield_T/Yield_C)) -> sdata
  
  sdata %>% 
    group_by(StudyID, ExperimentID, Top_Climate, TextureGroup, ConservationGroup, CoverCropGroup, GrainCropGroup) %>% 
    summarise(RR = mean(RR), logRR = mean(logRR),
              RR_yield = mean(RR_yield), logRR_yield = mean(logRR_yield)) -> sdata
  
  sdata %>% 
    ggplot(aes(RR)) + 
    geom_histogram(fill = "gray", col = "black") +
    labs(x = paste0("Response ratio of ", x_label),
         y = "Count") -> norm_RR
  
  sdata %>% 
    ggplot(aes(sample = RR)) +
    stat_qq() + 
    stat_qq_line() +
    labs(x = "Normal theoretical quantile",
         y = "Normal data quantile") -> qq_RR
  
  sdata %>% 
      ggplot(aes(logRR)) + 
      geom_histogram(fill = "gray", col = "black") +
      labs(x = paste0("Log (response ratio of ", x_label, " )"),
           y = "Count") -> normal_logRR
    
  sdata %>% 
    ggplot(aes(sample = logRR)) +
    stat_qq() + 
    stat_qq_line() +
    labs(x = "Normal theoretical quantile",
         y = "Normal data quantile") -> qq_logRR
  
  sdata %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y=logRR_yield, x = RR)) +
    geom_point() -> scattle_plot
  
   sdata %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y=logRR_yield, x = logRR)) +
    geom_point() -> scattle_plot_log
   
   ## do SLR
   slr_raw <- lm(sdata$logRR_yield ~ sdata$RR)
   sdata$student_res = rstandard(slr_raw)
   sdata$predict_yield = predict(slr_raw)
   
   sdata %>% 
     ggplot(aes(y = student_res, x = predict_yield)) +
     geom_point() +
     geom_hline(yintercept = 0) -> residual_plot_raw
   
   ## do SLR for log transfered data
   slr_log <- lm(sdata$logRR_yield ~ sdata$logRR)
   sdata$student_res_log = rstandard(slr_log)
   sdata$predict_yield_log = predict(slr_log)
   
   sdata %>% 
     ggplot(aes(y = student_res_log, x = predict_yield_log)) +
     geom_point() +
     geom_hline(yintercept = 0) -> residual_plot_log
   
   sdata %>% 
     ggplot(aes(y = student_res, x = predict_yield)) +
     geom_point() +
     geom_hline(yintercept = 0) -> residual_plot_raw
  
  (norm_RR / qq_RR / scattle_plot / residual_plot_raw) | (normal_logRR / qq_logRR / scattle_plot_log / residual_plot_log) -> plot_normal
  plot_normal + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") 
}

pdf( paste0('outputs/normal_test_all', ".pdf"), width=6, height=10)
factor_normal_test(sub_data, "Aggre_C", "Aggre_T", "aggregation")
factor_normal_test(sub_data, "AWHC_C", "AWHC_T", "AWHC")
factor_normal_test(sub_data, "BD_C", "BD_T", "bulk density")
factor_normal_test(sub_data, "BS_C", "BS_T", "BS")
factor_normal_test(sub_data, "pH_C", "pH_T", "pH")
dev.off()
```

```{r function for radar plot}
# install.packages('fmsb')
library(fmsb)

radar_plot <- function(sdata) {
  rbind(
    rep(1, nrow(sdata)) , rep(0,nrow(sdata)),
    sdata %>% 
      dplyr::select(indicator, SLR_R2) %>% 
      spread(key = indicator, value = SLR_R2)) -> radar_data
  
  # plot
  radarchart(radar_data %>% dplyr::select(-BiomassCash), # remove some indicators not interested in
           axistype=6 , vlcex=1.0, cglty=3)
}
```

```{r radar plot, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
             axistype=6 , vlcex=1.0 )
}
```

## bootstrap and get results for all variables
```{r}
boosting_variable <- function (sdata, term, treatment) {
  k = n_rep
  # n_sample: set it equals to the original sample size
  mysamples = replicate(k, sample(sdata$yi, replace=T))
  mymeans = apply(mysamples, 2, mean, na.rm = T)
  
  # quantile
  BootsTest <- quantile(mymeans,c(0.025, 0.50, 0.975))
  Boots_outputs <- tibble(term, treatment, (exp(BootsTest[[1]])-1)*100, (exp(BootsTest[[2]])-1)*100
                          , (exp(BootsTest[[3]])-1)*100, nrow(sdata), unique(sdata$StudyID) %>% length )
  colnames(Boots_outputs) <- c("Term", "Treatment", "Low", "Mean", "High", "obs", "n_study")
  return(Boots_outputs)
}
```

```{r Plot boots_variables results, fig.height=10, fig.width=8}
                     labels = c("MBN_Coarse","MBN_Medium","Infiltration_Coarse", "Infiltration_Medium", "Nmina_Corn", "Nmina_NotCorn", "SWC_AF","SWC_NotAF","Penetration_AF","Penetration_NotAF","MBN_Grass","MBN_Legume","Fungal_Grass","Fungal_Legume")) +
  geom_text(x=rep(-80,14),
            y=c(15.5,14.5,13.5,12.5,11,10,8.5, 7.5, 6.5, 5.5, 4, 3, 2, 1),
            label=paste0(boots_variables$obs,"/",boots_variables$n_study),
            size = 5,
            hjust = 0) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  xlim(c(-100, 250)) -> plot_boots_variables
```
